   435	// @ref LLP 3000.039#3 — source expiry is an ordinary reference-action closure, never an unchecked physical delete.
   436	pub(super) fn retire_snapshot(tx:&Tx<'_>,sources:&BTreeMap<String,Table>,previous:Option<&Schema>,now:i64)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
   437	    let mut source=previous.cloned().unwrap_or_default();source.tables=sources.clone();source.backfills.clear();source.prepare_receipt_dependencies();
   438	    let names:Vec<String>=source.through_order().into_iter().rev().filter(|n|source.tables[n].ephemeral.is_none() && source.maintain_for(n).is_none()).collect();
   439	    let mut due=false;
   440	    for name in &names {
   441	        let t=tx.num(name)?;
   442	        super::activation::walk(tx,t,|id,row|{if !due {due=source_expired(tx,t,id,&source.tables[name],&row,now)?;}Ok(())})?;
   443	    }
   444	    if !due{return Ok(())}
   445	    // Restored sources have no live index entries. Every reference action,
   446	    // maintained dependency and retained-child probe uses this assembled view.
   447	    for name in &names {
   448	        let table=&source.tables[name];
   449	        for (index,definition) in &table.indexes {
   450	            let ti=tx.num(&format!("{name}.{index}"))?;tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM i WHERE ti=?1",[ti])?;
   451	            let work=crate::rows::adoption::Work::table(table);
   452	            let scratch=|row:&Value|crate::rows::adoption::contribution_bytes(row,table);
   453	            super::activation_walk::walk_metered(tx,tx.num(name)?,work,if work.index_entries!=0 {Some(&scratch)}else{None},|id,mut row,_|{
   454	                materialize_optional_fields(&mut row,table);
   455	                for key in index_keys(definition,&row,id){tx.conn().execute("INSERT INTO i(ti,k,id) VALUES(?1,?2,?3)",params![ti,key,id])?;}Ok(())
   456	            })?;
   457	        }
   458	    }
   459	    if tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_schema WHERE name='_cap_counts')",[],|r|r.get::<_,bool>(0))? {
   460	        tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _cap_counts",[])?;
   461	        for name in &names {let table=&source.tables[name];super::activation::walk(tx,tx.num(name)?,|_,row|tx.update_cap_counts(name,table,None,Some(&row)).map(|_|()))?;}
   462	    }
   463	    validate_action_bounds(tx,&source,now)?;
   464	    tx.clear_activation_scan();
   465	    for name in &names {
   466	        let t=tx.num(name)?;
   467	        super::activation::walk(tx,t,|id,_|{
   468	            let Some(mut row)=tx.get(name,id)? else{return Ok(())};
   469	            if !source_expired(tx,t,id,&source.tables[name],&row,now)? {return Ok(())}
   470	            materialize_optional_fields(&mut row,&source.tables[name]);
   471	            let mut runner=Runner::new(tx,&source,Context::system().at(now),Meter::new(Ceilings::job(),Cut::Abort),tx.next_seq()?);
   472	            match runner.retire_expired_row(name,&row) {
   473	                Ok(true)=>{tx.set_meta("activation_population","true")?;},
   474	                Ok(false)=>return Err(refusal(format!("source expiry {name}/{id} is blocked by retained children; resolve them in a bridge before adoption"))),
   475	                Err(e)=>return Err(refusal(format!("source expiry {name}/{id}: {e}"))),
   476	            }Ok(())
   477	        })?;
   478	    }
   479	    for name in &names {
   480	        let cleared:Vec<_>=source.tables[name].on_delete.iter().filter(|(_,a)|**a==crate::schema::references::OnDelete::SetNull).map(|(c,_)|c.clone()).collect();
   481	        if cleared.is_empty(){continue;}
   482	        super::activation::walk(tx,tx.num(name)?,|id,row|{
   483	            for c in &cleared {if row.field(c).is_ok_and(|v|*v==Value::Null){tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _dormant_refs WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3",params![tx.num(name)?,id,c])?;}}Ok(())
   484	        })?;
   485	    }
   486	    tx.clear_activation_scan();Ok(())
   487	}
   488	fn source_expired(tx:&Tx<'_>,t:i64,id:&str,table:&Table,row:&Value,now:i64)->Result<bool,RuntimeError>{
   489	    if table.expired(row,now){return Ok(true)}
   490	    let definition:Option<String>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT definition FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",params![t,id],|r|r.get(0)).optional()?;
   491	    if let Some(definition)=definition {let old:Table=decode(&definition)?;return Ok(old.expired(row,now));}Ok(false)
   492	}
   493	
   494	fn validate_action_bounds(tx:&Tx<'_>,source:&Schema,now:i64)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
   495	    for parent in source.tables.keys() {for r in source.referencing(parent).into_iter().filter(|r|r.action.writes()) {
   496	        let bound=source.reference_cap(r.child,r.column).ok_or_else(||refusal("historical reference action has no bound"))?;
   497	        let index=source.reference_index(r.child,r.column).ok_or_else(||refusal("historical reference index absent"))?;
   498	        let mut q=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT k FROM i WHERE ti=?1 ORDER BY k")?;let mut rows=q.query([tx.num(&format!("{}.{index}",r.child))?])?;
   499	        let mut prior=None;let mut count=0u64;let mut visited=0u64;let mut meter=Meter::new(Ceilings::job(),Cut::Abort);
   500	        while let Some(row)=rows.next()? {
   501	            if visited%256==0 {meter=Meter::new(Ceilings::job(),Cut::Abort);}visited+=1;
   502	            let mark=meter.mark();let key=row.get_ref(0)?.as_blob().map_err(|e|RuntimeError::Store(e.to_string()))?;meter.heap(key.len() as u64 * 64 + 8192)?;
   503	            let values=crate::key::decode(key).ok_or_else(||refusal("invalid historical reference key"))?;
   504	            if values.first().is_none_or(|v|*v==Value::Null) || r.table.is_expiring() && values.get(1).is_some_and(|v|matches!(v,Value::Int(at) if *at<=now)) {meter.release_heap(mark);continue;}
   505	            if prior.as_ref()==values.first(){count+=1;}else{prior=values.first().cloned();count=1;}
   506	            if count>u64::from(bound){return Err(refusal(format!("historical reference group {}.{} exceeds retirement bound {bound}; reconcile retained capacity in a bridge before adoption",r.child,r.column)));}
   507	            meter.release_heap(mark);
   508	        }
   509	    }}Ok(())
   510	}

//! Release activation extends the existing engine transaction and generation.
// @ref LLP 3000.000.000#5-hot-activation-and-ownership — CAS includes every activation, not only semantic changes.
use super::*;
use rusqlite::OptionalExtension;

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct ReleaseActivation {
    pub release: u64,
    pub expected_previous: Option<u64>,
    pub expected_revision: Option<u64>,
    pub restore_dormant: bool,
    pub native_digest: Option<String>,
    pub operation: String,
}
impl ReleaseActivation {
    pub fn new(release: u64, expected_previous: Option<u64>) -> Self {
        Self {
            release,
            expected_previous,
            expected_revision: None,
            restore_dormant: true,
            native_digest: None,
            operation: "activate".into(),
        }
    }
    pub(crate) fn check(&self, conn: &rusqlite::Connection) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        let actual: Option<String> = conn
            .query_row("SELECT value FROM _meta WHERE key='release'", [], |r| {
                r.get(0)
            })
            .optional()?;
        if actual
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|s| s.parse::<u64>().ok() != self.expected_previous)
        {
            return Err(RuntimeError::Generation("current release changed; run `snapback4 releases <dir>` and retry the selected release".into()));
        }
        let revision: Option<String> = conn
            .query_row(
                "SELECT value FROM _meta WHERE key='release_revision'",
                [],
                |r| r.get(0),
            )
            .optional()?;
        let revision = revision.and_then(|v| v.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
        if self.expected_revision.is_some_and(|n| n != revision) {
            return Err(RuntimeError::Generation("activation revision changed (including rollback/equal-content activation); run `snapback4 releases <dir>` and retry".into()));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl Engine {
    pub fn new_release(
        store: Store,
        schema: Schema,
        programs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Program>,
        release: u64,
        expected_previous: Option<u64>,
    ) -> Result<Self, RuntimeError> {
        Self::new_release_with_feed_adoption(
            store,
            schema,
            programs,
            release,
            expected_previous,
            false,
        )
    }
    pub fn new_release_with_feed_adoption(
        store: Store,
        schema: Schema,
        programs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Program>,
        release: u64,
        expected_previous: Option<u64>,
        allow_feed_adoption: bool,
    ) -> Result<Self, RuntimeError> {
        Self::new_release_prepared(
            store,
            schema,
            programs,
            &ReleaseActivation::new(release, expected_previous),
            allow_feed_adoption,
        )
    }
    pub fn new_release_prepared(
        store: Store, schema: Schema, programs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Program>,
        options: &ReleaseActivation, allow_feed_adoption: bool,
    ) -> Result<Self, RuntimeError> {
        Self::new_release_prepared_at(store,schema,programs,options,allow_feed_adoption,crate::now_ms())
    }
    pub fn new_release_prepared_at(
        mut store: Store,
        mut schema: Schema,
        programs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Program>,
        options: &ReleaseActivation,
        allow_feed_adoption: bool,
        now: i64,
    ) -> Result<Self, RuntimeError> {
        prepare(&mut schema)?;
        let programs = programs.into_iter().map(|p| (p.name.clone(), p)).collect();
        let (generation, metadata) = Self::activate(
            &mut store,
            &schema,
            &programs,
            Some(options),
            now,
            allow_feed_adoption,
            None,
            None,
        )?;
        store.exclude_ephemeral(&schema);
        Ok(Self {
            timeline_schedule: timeline::Schedule::default(),
            ephemeral: std::sync::Arc::new(ephemeral::Hub::new(
                metadata.store_id,
                generation,
                &schema,
            )),
            store,
            schema,
            programs,
            generation,
            expiry_after: BTreeMap::new(),
            dev_effects: false,
            ceilings: Ceilings::default(),
            entropy: crate::ids::seed(),
            minter: crate::ids::Mint::default(),
            #[cfg(feature = "native")]
            native: None,
            #[cfg(feature = "native")]
            native_logs: native::Logs::default(),
            presence: None,
        })
    }
    /// No replacement engine, post-commit SQL read, or fallible ephemeral swap.
    pub fn adopt_release(
        &mut self, schema: Schema, programs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Program>,
        options: &ReleaseActivation, allow_feed_adoption: bool,
    ) -> Result<u64, RuntimeError> {
        self.adopt_release_at(schema,programs,options,allow_feed_adoption,crate::now_ms())
    }
    pub fn adopt_release_at(
        &mut self,
        mut schema: Schema,
        programs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Program>,
        options: &ReleaseActivation,
        allow_feed_adoption: bool,
        now: i64,
    ) -> Result<u64, RuntimeError> {
        prepare(&mut schema)?;
        let programs = programs.into_iter().map(|p| (p.name.clone(), p)).collect();
        drop(self.ephemeral.lock()?);
        let (generation, metadata) = Self::activate(
            &mut self.store,
            &schema,
            &programs,
            Some(options),
            now,
            allow_feed_adoption,
            None,
            None,
        )?;
        self.store.exclude_ephemeral(&schema);
        self.timeline_schedule = timeline::Schedule::default();
        self.schema = schema;
        self.programs = programs;
        self.generation = generation;
        self.expiry_after.clear();
        self.dev_effects = false;
        self.ephemeral
            .rebind_committed(metadata.store_id, generation, &self.schema);
        Ok(generation)
    }
    #[cfg(feature = "native")]
    pub fn set_prepared_native(&mut self, module: Option<std::sync::Arc<native::Module>>) {
        self.native = module;
    }
}

fn prepare(schema: &mut Schema) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    columns::validate_before_prepare(schema)?;
    schema.check_row_view_audiences()?;
    schema.prepare_contribution_indexes();
    schema.prepare_delivery_lookup();
    if let Some(issue) = crate::schema::validate(schema).first() {
        return Err(RuntimeError::Schema(format!(
            "{}: {}",
            issue.path, issue.message
        )));
    }
    Ok(())
}
//! Server activation builder; all fallible work precedes commit.
use super::*;
impl Engine {
    pub(super) fn activate(
        store: &mut Store,
        schema: &Schema,
        programs: &BTreeMap<String, Program>,
        release: Option<&release::ReleaseActivation>,
        now: i64,
        allow_feed_adoption: bool,
        expected_release: Option<u64>,
        expected_backend: Option<&crate::store::opening::Backend>,
    ) -> Result<(u64, crate::store::opening::Metadata), RuntimeError> {
        schema.validate_column_owners()?;
        for program in programs.values() {
            crate::schema::ephemeral::admit_program(schema, program)?;
            admission::check_state_predicates(schema, program)?;
        }
        for program in programs.values() {
            for table in crate::ir::read_sites(program)
                .into_iter()
                .map(|s| s.table)
                .chain(crate::ir::write_tables(program).into_iter().map(|(t, _)| t))
            {
                schema.refuse_private(&table)?;
            }
        }
        for schedule in &schema.schedules {
            if !schedule.valid()
            {
                return Err(RuntimeError::Schema(format!(
                    "schedule {} has an invalid period or offset",
                    schedule.name
                )));
            }
            let Some(program) = programs
                .get(&schedule.target)
                .filter(|p| matches!(p.kind, ProgramKind::Job | ProgramKind::Action))
            else {
                return Err(RuntimeError::Schema(format!(
                    "schedule {} names missing job or action {}; restore or remove the schedule",
                    schedule.name, schedule.target
                )));
            };
            if program.kind == ProgramKind::Action {
                let seat = schedule
                    .service
                    .as_deref()
                    .filter(|seat| crate::identity::is_service(seat))
                    .ok_or_else(|| {
                        RuntimeError::Schema(
                            "a scheduled action requires its declared service seat".into(),
                        )
                    })?;
                actions::authorize(program, seat)?;
            } else if schedule.service.is_some() {
                return Err(RuntimeError::Schema(
                    "a scheduled job cannot name a service seat".into(),
                ));
            }
            if program.args.iter().any(|(name, kind)| {
                !matches!(name.as_str(), "periodStart" | "periodEnd")
                    || *kind != crate::ir::ArgType::Time
            }) {
                return Err(RuntimeError::Schema(
                    "scheduled work takes periodStart: time and periodEnd: time, or nothing".into(),
                ));
            }
        }
        let prior_items = std::cell::RefCell::new(Vec::new());
        let population=std::cell::Cell::new(None);
        let outcome=store.activate_at_with_launch(schema, Some(programs), false, now, allow_feed_adoption, |conn| {
            Store::check_selected_release(conn, expected_release)?;
            if let Some(backend) = expected_backend { backend.check(conn)?; }
            if let Some(options)=release {
                options.check(conn)?;
                *prior_items.borrow_mut()=crate::store::release_history::inventory(conn,None,usize::MAX)?;
                crate::store::dormant::enable(conn)?;
                conn.execute("INSERT INTO _meta(key,value) VALUES('release_native_digest',?1) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value",[options.native_digest.as_deref().unwrap_or("")])?;
                conn.execute("INSERT INTO _meta(key,value) VALUES('activation_restore',?1) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value",[if options.restore_dormant {"true"}else{"false"}])?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }, |tx, changed, report| {
            let now=now.max(tx.time_audience_clock()?);
            if let Some(options)=release {tx.set_meta("release",&options.release.to_string())?;}
            use rusqlite::OptionalExtension;
            let repair_live_sums = tx.conn().query_row("SELECT value FROM _meta WHERE key = 'live_sum_candidates'", [], |row| row.get::<_, String>(0)).optional()?.as_deref() != Some("1");
            let previous: Option<String> = tx.conn().query_row("SELECT schema FROM _generations WHERE generation = (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM _meta WHERE key = 'generation')", [], |row| row.get(0)).optional()?;
            let previous: Option<Schema> = previous.map(|text| serde_json::from_str(&text).map_err(|e| RuntimeError::decode(e, RuntimeError::Store))).transpose()?;
            let needs_maintained_id_marker = (schema.maintains.iter().any(|maintain| maintain.row_key.is_none())
                || previous.as_ref().is_some_and(|old| old.maintains.iter().any(|maintain| maintain.row_key.is_none())))
                && tx.meta(crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_META)?.as_deref() != Some(crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_VERSION);
            if !changed && !repair_live_sums && !needs_maintained_id_marker { return Ok(()); }
            let repair_maintained_ids = needs_maintained_id_marker
                && previous.as_ref().is_some_and(|old| old.maintains.iter().any(|maintain| maintain.row_key.is_none()));
            if changed {
                let epoch = tx.next_seq()?;
                for table in partition::changed_group_audiences(previous.as_ref(), schema) {
                    tx.set_meta(&partition::audience_epoch_key(&table), &epoch.to_string())?;
                    tx.set_meta(&partition::audience_epoch_time_key(&table), &now.to_string())?;
                }
            }
            let population_changed=tx.meta("activation_population")?.as_deref()==Some("true");
            let rebuild: Vec<_> = schema.maintains.iter().filter(|m| {
                (changed && (population_changed || previous.as_ref().is_none_or(|old| crate::successor::maintain_rebuild_needed(old, schema, m))))
                    || (repair_maintained_ids && m.row_key.is_none())
                    || (repair_live_sums && matches!(m.kind, crate::schema::MaintainKind::Sum { .. }) && schema.table(&m.source).is_some_and(|source| source.is_expiring()))
            }).collect();
            tx.set_meta("live_sum_candidates", "1")?;
            if needs_maintained_id_marker {
                // This write is inside the activation transaction: a failed
                // rebuild leaves both old rows and the old/missing marker. A
                // first aggregate has no legacy target identity to rewrite,
                // but records the current address function for later opens.
                tx.set_meta(crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_META, crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_VERSION)?;
            }
            let attribution = recorded::paths_changed(schema, previous.as_ref());
            let columns = column_activation::changed_parents(schema, if population_changed {None} else {previous.as_ref()});
            if rebuild.is_empty() && !attribution && columns.is_empty() && !repair_maintained_ids { return Ok(()); }
            let seq = tx.next_seq()?;
            let phase = std::time::Instant::now();
            if attribution {
                // This runner owns only activation rewrites; ordinary rebuilds
                // below retain their commit and partition accounting.
                let mut capture = Runner::new(tx, schema, Context::system().at(now), Meter::new(Ceilings::unbounded(), Cut::Abort), seq);
                capture.capture_activation(previous.as_ref(), Some(report))?;
                report.detail("capture recorded paths", phase);
                // A newly introduced aggregate has no legacy identity map to
                // preserve. Keep its event-free recorded-path rebuild out of
                // commit accounting, as activation did before the address
                // migration existed.
                if !repair_maintained_ids {
                    capture.rebuild_recorded_activation(previous.as_ref(), &rebuild.iter().copied().filter(|m| m.private.is_none()).collect::<Vec<_>>(), report)?;
                }
            }
            let mut runner = Runner::new(tx, schema, Context::system().at(now), Meter::new(Ceilings::unbounded(), Cut::Abort), seq);
            if repair_maintained_ids {
                let started = std::time::Instant::now();
                let rewritten = runner.rewrite_legacy_maintained_references(&rebuild.iter().copied().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>(), previous.as_ref(), Some(tx))?;
                if rewritten != 0 { report.changes.push(format!("rewrote {rewritten} legacy aggregate references")); }
                report.detail("rewrite legacy aggregate references", started);
            }
            // Legacy maps must be captured before any activation rebuild can
            // remove their target rows. Recorded values themselves are
            // stamped first so their historical paths may still traverse the
            // predecessor addresses.
            if attribution && repair_maintained_ids {
                runner.rebuild_recorded_activation(previous.as_ref(), &rebuild.iter().copied().filter(|m| m.private.is_none()).collect::<Vec<_>>(), report)?;
            }
            runner.activate_columns(previous.as_ref(), &rebuild, &columns, Some(report))?;
            for maintain in rebuild.into_iter().filter(|m| m.private.is_none()) {
                if !recorded::table_paths_changed(schema.table(&maintain.source), previous.as_ref().and_then(|s| s.table(&maintain.source))) {
                    runner.rebuild_maintain_reported(maintain, report)?;
                }
            }
            let events = runner.events.take();
            let tables: Vec<String> = runner.written_tables.iter().cloned().collect();
            let written = runner.rows_written;
            drop(runner);
            if written > 0 || !columns.is_empty() {
                tx.record_commit(seq, now, "rebuild", crate::SYSTEM_PRINCIPAL, "rebuild", &tables, written)?;
                partition::append(tx, seq, &events)?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }, |tx| {
            if let Some(options)=release {
                crate::store::release_history::finalize_restorations(tx)?;
                let mut items=crate::store::release_history::inventory(tx.conn(),None,usize::MAX)?;
                let dormant_items=items.len();
                let mut restored_items=0usize;
                for item in &mut items {
                    let before=prior_items.borrow().iter().find(|i|i.key==item.key).cloned();
                    let count=before.as_ref().map_or(0,|i|i.rows);
                    item.before_rows=Some(count);item.after_rows=Some(item.rows);
                    item.before_sample_ids=Some(before.map_or_else(Vec::new,|i|i.sample_ids));
                    let restored=if item.kind=="rows" {
                        tx.meta(&format!("activation_narrowed_restored:{}",item.path))?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0)
                    } else if item.kind=="column" {tx.meta(&format!("activation_column_restored:{}",item.path))?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0)} else {0};
                    item.restored_rows=Some(restored);
                    if restored>0 {item.action="partially restored".into();restored_items+=1;}
                }
                let remaining:std::collections::BTreeSet<_>=items.iter().map(|i|i.key.clone()).collect();
                for mut item in prior_items.borrow().iter().filter(|i|!remaining.contains(&i.key)).cloned() {
                    let restored=if matches!(item.kind.as_str(),"rows"|"column") {
                        let prefix=if item.kind=="rows" {"activation_narrowed_restored"} else {"activation_column_restored"};
                        tx.meta(&format!("{prefix}:{}",item.path))?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0)
                    } else if item.kind=="table" {
                        tx.meta(&format!("activation_table_restored:{}",item.path))?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0)
                    } else {item.rows};
                    item.action=if restored>0 || item.definition_only {"restored"} else {"removed without restoration"}.into();
                    item.before_rows=Some(item.rows);item.after_rows=Some(0);item.restored_rows=Some(restored);item.before_sample_ids=Some(item.sample_ids.clone());
                    if restored>0 || item.definition_only {restored_items+=1;}
                    items.push(item);
                }
                population.set(Some((tx.meta("activation_narrowed_retained")?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0),tx.meta("activation_narrowed_restored")?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0))));
                crate::store::release_history::event(tx,&options.operation,Some(options.release),options.expected_previous,serde_json::json!({"dormant_items":dormant_items,"restored_items":restored_items,"native_digest":options.native_digest,"narrowed_retained":tx.meta("activation_narrowed_retained")?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0),"narrowed_restored":tx.meta("activation_narrowed_restored")?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0)}),&items)?;
                tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _meta WHERE key IN ('activation_restore','activation_population','activation_narrowed_retained','activation_narrowed_restored') OR key LIKE 'activation_narrowed_restored:%' OR key LIKE 'activation_column_restored:%' OR key LIKE 'activation_table_restored:%' OR key LIKE 'activation_table_restored_ids:%' OR key LIKE 'activation_narrowed_restored_ids:%' OR key LIKE 'activation_column_restored_ids:%'",[])?;
            }
            crate::store::opening::Metadata::read(tx)
        });
        if outcome.is_ok() {
            if let Some((retained,restored))=population.get().filter(|(a,b)|*a>0 || *b>0) {
                store.adoption_report.changes.insert(0,format!("{retained} newly dormant {}; {restored} narrowed {} restored", if retained == 1 { "row" } else { "rows" }, if restored == 1 { "row" } else { "rows" }));
            }
        }
        if outcome.is_ok() {
            if let Ok(items)=store.dormant_inventory(None,usize::MAX) {
                if release.is_some() { store.adoption_report.changes.insert(0, crate::store::adoption_report::AdoptionReport::dormant(&items)); }
            }
        }
        outcome
    }
}

    96	    fn activate_transaction_with<R>(&mut self, schema: &Schema, programs: Option<&BTreeMap<String, Program>>, reset: bool, now: i64, allow_launch: bool, check: impl FnOnce(&Connection) -> Result<(), RuntimeError>, build: impl FnOnce(&Tx<'_>, bool, &mut super::adoption_report::AdoptionReport) -> Result<(), RuntimeError>, finish: impl FnOnce(&Tx<'_>) -> Result<R, RuntimeError>,
    97	    ) -> Result<(u64, R), RuntimeError> {
    98	        // @ref LLP 3000.000.000.002#4-staging-clock — a removed opening boundary cannot lower durable source retirement time.

   129	        // Physical INSERT/UPDATE triggers invalidate the proof on oversized keys,

   133	        let key_proof = before.1.as_ref().map(|hash| format!("{}:{hash}", crate::rows::MAX_INDEX_KEY_BYTES));
   134	        let validated: Option<String> = sql.query_row("SELECT value FROM _meta WHERE key = 'index_keys_validated'", [], |r|r.get(0)).optional()?;
   135	        let keys_validated = programs.is_some() && key_proof.is_some() && validated == key_proof;
   136	        #[cfg(test)]

   143	                [crate::rows::MAX_INDEX_KEY_BYTES as i64], |row| Ok((row.get(0)?, row.get(1)?))
   144	            ).optional()?;
   145	            if let Some((name, count)) = violation {
   146	                let (table, index) = name.rsplit_once('.').unwrap_or((&name, "unknown"));
   147	                return Err(crate::rows::index_key_refusal(table, index, count as u64));

    52	pub(super) fn definition(tx: &Tx<'_>, name: &str, table: &Table, column: &str) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    53	    let value = Column {

    63	fn references(kind: &ColumnType, value: &Value, out: &mut Vec<(String, String)>) {
    64	    match (kind, value) {
    65	        (ColumnType::Optional(inner), value) => references(inner, value, out),
    66	        (ColumnType::List { of, .. } | ColumnType::ListRange { of, .. }, Value::Array(values)) => {
    67	            for value in values {
    68	                references(of, value, out);
    69	            }
    70	        }
    71	        (ColumnType::Ref { table }, Value::Id(id)) => out.push((table.clone(), id.clone())),
    72	        _ => {}
    73	    }
    74	}
    75	
    76	fn rewrite_legacy_reference(
    77	    kind: &ColumnType,
    78	    value: &mut Value,
    79	    ids: &BTreeMap<String, BTreeMap<String, String>>,
    80	) -> bool {
    81	    match (kind, value) {
    82	        (ColumnType::Ref { table }, Value::Id(id)) => {
    83	            let Some(next) = ids.get(table).and_then(|ids| ids.get(id)) else { return false };
    84	            *id = next.clone();
    85	            true
    86	        }
    87	        (ColumnType::Optional(inner), value) => rewrite_legacy_reference(inner, value, ids),
    88	        (ColumnType::List { of, .. } | ColumnType::ListRange { of, .. }, Value::Array(values)) =>
    89	            values.iter_mut().fold(false, |changed, value| rewrite_legacy_reference(of, value, ids) || changed),
    90	        _ => false,
    91	    }
    92	}
    93	
    94	fn rewrite_legacy_row(
    95	    table: &Table,
    96	    row: &mut Value,
    97	    ids: &BTreeMap<String, BTreeMap<String, String>>,
    98	) -> bool {
    99	    let (Value::Row(fields) | Value::Map(fields)) = row else { return false };
   100	    table.columns.iter().fold(false, |changed, (column, kind)| {
   101	        fields.get_mut(column).is_some_and(|value| rewrite_legacy_reference(kind, value, ids)) || changed
   102	    })
   103	}

   160	        for (old, next) in target_ids {

   162	            tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _dormant_refs WHERE parent_t=?1 AND parent_id=?2", params![parent_t,old])?;
   163	        }
   164	    }
   165	    Ok(rewritten)
   166	}
   167	
   168	pub(super) fn capture_refs(
   169	    tx: &Tx<'_>,
   170	    t: i64,
   171	    id: &str,
   172	    column: &str,
   173	    kind: &ColumnType,
   174	    value: &Value,
   175	) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
   176	    tx.conn().execute(
   177	        "DELETE FROM _dormant_refs WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3",
   178	        params![t, id, column],
   179	    )?;
   180	    let mut refs = Vec::new();
   181	    references(kind, value, &mut refs);
   182	    for (parent, parent_id) in refs {
   183	        add_reference(tx, t, id, column, &parent, &parent_id)?;
   184	    }
   185	    Ok(())
   186	}
   187	
   188	fn add_reference(
   189	    tx: &Tx<'_>,
   190	    t: i64,
   191	    id: &str,
   192	    column: &str,
   193	    parent: &str,
   194	    parent_id: &str,
   195	) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
   196	    let parent_t = tx.num(parent)?;
   197	    let invalid = !tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2)",params![parent_t,parent_id],|r|r.get::<_,bool>(0))?
   198	        && !tx.conn().query_row(
   199	            "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2)",
   200	            params![parent_t, parent_id],
   201	            |r| r.get::<_, bool>(0),
   202	        )?;
   203	    tx.conn().execute(
   204	        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _dormant_refs VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5,?6)",
   205	        params![t, id, column, parent_t, parent_id, if invalid {2} else {0}],
   206	    )?;
   207	    Ok(())
   208	}
   209	pub(super) fn capture_through_parent(
   210	    tx: &Tx<'_>,
   211	    name: &str,
   212	    table: &Table,
   213	    id: &str,
   214	    column: &str,
   215	    row: &Value,
   216	) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
   217	    if let Some(through) = &table.through {
   218	        if (through.fields.contains_key(column)
   219	            || matches!(
   220	                column,
   221	                crate::schema::through::PARENT_DEADLINE | crate::schema::through::DEADLINE
   222	            ))
   223	            && let Ok(Value::Id(parent_id)) = row.field(&through.reference)
   224	        {
   225	            add_reference(tx, tx.num(name)?, id, column, &through.parent, parent_id)?;
   226	        }
   227	    }
   228	    Ok(())
   229	}
   230	
   231	pub(super) fn save_cell(
   232	    tx: &Tx<'_>,
   233	    name: &str,
   234	    table: &Table,
   235	    id: &str,
   236	    column: &str,
   237	    value: &Value,
   238	    capture: bool,
   239	) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
   240	    let t = tx.num(name)?;
   241	    // @ref LLP 3000.014.000#implementation-proof-clarifications — another row cannot overwrite a cell's live origin.
   242	    let live=table.engine_field(column) && table.through.as_ref().is_some_and(|e|e.live.is_some());
   243	    tx.conn().execute("INSERT INTO _dormant_values(t,id,column_name,data,live_source) VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5) ON CONFLICT(t,id,column_name) DO UPDATE SET data=excluded.data,live_source=excluded.live_source",params![t,id,column,canonical_json(value),i64::from(live)])?;
   244	    if capture && !super::authority_origin::live_input(table,column) {
   245	        capture_refs(tx, t, id, column, &table.columns[column], value)
   246	    } else {
   247	        Ok(())
   248	    }
   249	}
   250	
   251	fn refuse(message: String) -> RuntimeError {
   252	    RuntimeError::Structural {
   253	        code: "E_ADOPT",
   254	        message,
   255	    }
   256	}

   258	pub(super) fn check_owner(tx: &Tx<'_>, name: &str, old: &Table, next: &Schema) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
   259	    let Some(new) = next.table(name) else {
   260	        return Ok(());
   261	    };
   262	    let evidence = || -> Result<String, RuntimeError> {
   263	        let mut samples = super::adopt_refusals::Samples::default();
   264	        super::activation::walk(tx, tx.num(name)?, |id, _| {
   265	            samples.add(id, "storage ownership");
   266	            Ok(())
   267	        })?;
   268	        if samples.count == 0 {
   269	            let t = tx.num(name)?;
   270	            let count: i64 =
   271	                tx.conn()
   272	                    .query_row("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM _dormant_rows WHERE t=?1", [t], |r| {
   273	                        r.get(0)
   274	                    })?;
   275	            let ids = tx
   276	                .conn()
   277	                .prepare("SELECT id FROM _dormant_rows WHERE t=?1 ORDER BY id LIMIT 5")?
   278	                .query_map([t], |r| r.get::<_, String>(0))?
   279	                .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
   280	            return Ok(format!(
   281	                "{count} affected rows; sample ids [{}]",
   282	                ids.iter()
   283	                    .map(|i| super::adopt_refusals::bounded(i))
   284	                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
   285	                    .join(", ")
   286	            ));
   287	        }
   288	        Ok(samples.describe())
   289	    };
   290	    if new.ephemeral.is_some() {
   291	        return Err(refuse(format!(
   292	            "table {name}: {}; durable storage cannot become ephemeral; deploy without {name}, run `snapback4 prune <dir> --allow-destructive`, then deploy the ephemeral table",
   293	            evidence()?
   294	        )));
   295	    }
   296	    if next.maintain_for(name).is_some() {
   297	        return Err(refuse(format!(
   298	            "table {name}: {}; authoritative storage cannot become a derived table; rename the derived table, or retire {name}, run `snapback4 prune <dir> --allow-destructive`, then deploy",
   299	            evidence()?
   300	        )));
   301	    }
   302	    for column in old
   303	        .columns
   304	        .keys()
   305	        .filter(|column| authoritative(old, column))
   306	    {
   307	        if new.columns.contains_key(column) && !authoritative(new, column) {
   308	            return Err(refuse(format!(
   309	                "column {name}.{column}: {}; authoritative values cannot become maintained/captured values; rename the new column, or retire it, run `snapback4 prune <dir> --allow-destructive`, then deploy",
   310	                evidence()?
   311	            )));
   312	        }
   313	    }
   314	    Ok(())
   315	}

   652	fn check_references(tx: &Tx<'_>, next: &Schema,sources:&BTreeMap<String,Table>) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
   653	    for (name, table) in next.tables.iter().filter(|(_, t)| t.ephemeral.is_none()) {
   654	        let t = tx.num(name)?;
   655	        let mut bad = super::adopt_refusals::Samples::default();
   656	        let mut statement=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT DISTINCT d.id,d.column_name,d.parent_id,d.invalid FROM _dormant_refs d LEFT JOIN r p ON p.t=d.parent_t AND p.id=d.parent_id WHERE d.t=?1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r child WHERE child.t=d.t AND child.id=d.id) AND (d.invalid=1 OR (p.id IS NULL AND d.invalid!=2)) ORDER BY d.id,d.column_name")?;
   657	        let mut rows = statement.query([t])?;
   658	        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {
   659	            let column: String = row.get(1)?;
   660	            let id:String=row.get(0)?;
   661	            if table.columns.contains_key(&column) && !super::authority_origin::obsolete_ref(tx,t,&id,&column,table,sources.get(name))? {
   662	                bad.add(
   663	                    &row.get::<_, String>(0)?,
   664	                    &format!(
   665	                        "{column} → parent {} (deleted/reused/missing)",
   666	                        row.get::<_, String>(2)?
   667	                    ),
   668	                );
   669	            }
   670	        }
   671	        if bad.count > 0 {
   672	            return Err(refuse(format!(
   673	                "table {name}: {}; dormant references cannot acquire another parent lifetime; keep the current release and repair the named references, or prune the dormant storage before restoring",
   674	                bad.describe()
   675	            )));
   676	        }
   677	        if let Some(through) = &table.through {
   678	            {
   679	                let mut bad = super::adopt_refusals::Samples::default();
   680	                super::activation_walk::walk_metered(tx,t,crate::rows::adoption::Work::DECODE,None,|id,row,meter| {
   681	                    let restored: bool = tx.conn().query_row(
   682	                        "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_refs WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2)",
   683	                        params![t, id],
   684	                        |r| r.get(0),
   685	                    )?;
   686	                    if !restored {
   687	                        return Ok(());
   688	                    }
   689	                    // The captured deadline belongs to one parent lifetime,
   690	                    // even if an older schema allowed retargeting the active ref.
   691	                    let parent_t = tx.num(&through.parent)?;
   692	                    let current = row
   693	                        .field(&through.reference)
   694	                        .ok()
   695	                        .and_then(|v| v.as_str().ok());
   696	                    let mut evidence=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT parent_t,parent_id,(SELECT name FROM _catalog WHERE num=parent_t) FROM _dormant_refs WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3")?;
   697	                    for edge in evidence.query_map(
   698	                        params![t, id, crate::schema::through::PARENT_DEADLINE],
   699	                        |r| {
   700	                            Ok((
   701	                                r.get::<_, i64>(0)?,
   702	                                r.get::<_, String>(1)?,
   703	                                r.get::<_, String>(2)?,
   704	                            ))
   705	                        },
   706	                    )? {
   707	                        let (old_table, old_id, old_name) = edge?;
   708	                        if old_table != parent_t || current != Some(old_id.as_str()) {
   709	                            bad.add(
   710	                                id,
   711	                                &format!(
   712	                                    "{}.{}: recorded {} [{}], current {} [{}]",
   713	                                    name,
   714	                                    through.reference,
   715	                                    old_name,
   716	                                    old_id,
   717	                                    through.parent,
   718	                                    current.unwrap_or("<missing>")
   719	                                ),
   720	                            );
   721	                            return Ok(());
   722	                        }
   723	                    }
   724	                    if let Ok(Value::Id(parent_id)) = row.field(&through.reference) {
   725	                        if through.live.is_some() || crate::rows::Rows::restored_live_authority(tx,name,id)? {
   726	                            let bytes:Option<i64>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT octet_length(data) FROM r WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",params![parent_t,parent_id],|r|r.get(0)).optional()?;
   727	                            meter.heap((bytes.unwrap_or(0) as u64).saturating_mul(64).saturating_add(4096))?;
   728	                        }
   729	                        if let Some(parent) = tx.get(&through.parent, parent_id)? {
   730	                            let parent =
   731	                                crate::schema::row_image(&parent, &next.tables[&through.parent]);
   732	                            // @ref LLP 3000.014.000#71-dormant-restoration-identities-are-a-relation — live policy restamps current inputs after preserving parent lifetime.
   733	                            if through.live.is_none() && !crate::rows::Rows::restored_live_authority(tx,name,id)? && through.fields.iter().any(|(capture, field)| {
   734	                                row.field(capture)
   735	                                    .ok()
   736	                                    .is_some_and(|value| Some(value) != parent.field(field).ok())
   737	                            }) {
   738	                                bad.add(id,&format!("{}.{} parent {parent_id}: captured audience/identity changed",name,through.reference));
   739	                            }
   740	                        }
   741	                    }
   742	                    Ok(())
   743	                })?;
   744	                if bad.count > 0 {
   745	                    return Err(refuse(format!(
   746	                        "table {name}: {}; restore cannot rebind historical audience/deadline captures; restore the original parent reference and audience under the current release, then `snapback4 rollback <dir> --to N`, or explicitly `snapback4 prune <dir> --allow-destructive`",
   747	                        bad.describe()
   748	                    )));
   749	                }
   750	            }
   751	        }
   752	    }
   753	    Ok(())
   754	}

   756	pub(super) fn delete(tx: &Tx<'_>, t: i64, id: &str, name: &str) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
   757	    super::backfills::delete(tx,t,id)?;
   758	    if !enabled(tx)? {
   759	        return Ok(());
   760	    }
   761	    tx.conn().execute(
   762	        "UPDATE _dormant_refs SET invalid=1 WHERE parent_t=?1 AND parent_id=?2 AND invalid=0",
   763	        params![t, id],
   764	    )?;
   765	    let narrowed=super::narrowed::present(tx.conn())?;
   766	    let home=if narrowed {" OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE t=?4 AND id=?2)"} else {""};
   767	    tx.conn().execute(&format!("UPDATE _assets SET released_at=COALESCE(released_at,?3) WHERE home_table=?1 AND home_id=?2 AND (home_column IN (SELECT column_name FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?4 AND id=?2){home})"),params![name,id,crate::now_ms(),t])?;
   768	    tx.conn().execute(
   769	        "DELETE FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",
   770	        params![t, id],
   771	    )?;
   772	    tx.conn().execute(
   773	        "DELETE FROM _dormant_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",
   774	        params![t, id],
   775	    )?;
   776	    if narrowed {tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",params![t,id])?;}
   777	    tx.conn().execute(
   778	        "DELETE FROM _dormant_refs WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",
   779	        params![t, id],
   780	    )?;
   781	    Ok(())
   782	}

   784	pub(super) fn holds_home(tx: &Tx<'_>, table: &str, column: &str) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
   785	    if !enabled(tx)? {
   786	        return Ok(false);
   787	    }
   788	    let narrowed=if super::narrowed::present(tx.conn())? {" OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_narrow_rows n JOIN _catalog c ON n.t=c.num WHERE c.name=?1)"}else{""};
   789	    Ok(tx.conn().query_row(&format!("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_tables WHERE table_name=?1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_columns WHERE table_name=?1 AND column_name=?2){narrowed}"),params![table,column],|r|r.get(0))?)

   792	/// Fetch only destination cells on live transitions, after paying their full
   793	/// serialized/decoded coexistence in the owning activation page/row account.
   794	pub(super) fn restored_values(tx:&Tx<'_>,t:i64,id:&str,table:&Table,meter:&mut crate::meter::Meter)->Result<Vec<(String,String)>,RuntimeError> {
   795	    if !super::live_activation::active(tx)? {
   796	        return Ok(tx.conn().prepare_cached("SELECT column_name,data FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2")?.query_map(params![t,id],|r|Ok((r.get(0)?,r.get(1)?)))?.collect::<Result<_,_>>()?);
   797	    }
   798	    let mut values=Vec::new();
   799	    for column in table.columns.keys() {
   800	        let bytes:Option<i64>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT octet_length(data) FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3",params![t,id,column],|r|r.get(0)).optional()?;
   801	        if let Some(bytes)=bytes {
   802	            meter.heap((bytes as u64).saturating_mul(64).saturating_add(1024+column.len() as u64*8))?;
   803	            let data:String=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT data FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3",params![t,id,column],|r|r.get(0))?;
   804	            values.push((column.clone(),data));
   805	        }
   806	    }
   807	    Ok(values)
   808	}

   815	    }Ok(())
   816	}

    14	fn incompatible(tx:&Tx<'_>,schema: &Schema, name: &str, row: &Value) -> Result<bool,RuntimeError> {
    15	    incompatible_except(tx,schema,name,row,&[])

    17	fn incompatible_except(tx:&Tx<'_>,schema: &Schema,name:&str,row:&Value,authority:&[String])->Result<bool,RuntimeError> {
    18	    let table = &schema.tables[name];
    19	    for (column,kind) in &table.columns {
    20	        if table.engine_field(column) || table.maintained.contains_key(column) || authority.contains(column) {continue;}
    21	        if let Ok(value)=row.field(column) {
    22	            if incompatible_column(tx, table, name, column, kind, value)? { return Ok(true); }
    23	        }
    24	    }
    25	    Ok(false)
    26	}

    28	// @ref LLP 3000.000.000#11-wave-11-factual-release-narration — the warning and activation share the value predicate, including ledger-backed assets.
    29	pub(super) fn incompatible_column(tx: &Tx<'_>, table: &Table, name: &str, column: &str, kind: &ColumnType, value: &Value) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
    30	    if crate::engine::validate::validate_column(name, column, kind, Some(value)).is_err() { return Ok(true); }
    31	    // @ref LLP 3000.038#1-the-type — asset facts belong to the ledger, including optional/list leaves.
    32	    match super::activation::validate_assets(tx, kind, Some(value)) {
    33	        Err(RuntimeError::Asset { code: "E_ASSET_TYPE" | "E_ASSET_TOO_LARGE", .. }) => return Ok(true),
    34	        Err(error) => return Err(error),
    35	        Ok(()) => (),
    36	    }
    37	    Ok(table.constraints.iter().any(|c| matches!(c, Constraint::Text { field, min, format }
    38	        if field == column && matches!(value, Value::String(s)
    39	            if crate::engine::validate::validate_text(field, s, *min, *format).is_err()))))
    40	}
    41	
    42	fn refs(kind: &ColumnType, value: &Value, out: &mut Vec<(String, String)>) {
    43	    match (kind, value) {
    44	        (ColumnType::Optional(inner), v) => refs(inner, v, out),
    45	        (ColumnType::List { of, .. } | ColumnType::ListRange { of, .. }, Value::Array(vs)) => {
    46	            for v in vs {
    47	                refs(of, v, out);
    48	            }
    49	        }
    50	        (ColumnType::Ref { table }, Value::Id(id)) => out.push((table.clone(), id.clone())),
    51	        _ => {}
    52	    }
    53	}

    55	pub(super) fn transition(
    56	    tx: &Tx<'_>,
    57	    next: &Schema,
    58	    previous: Option<&Schema>,
    59	    now: i64,
    60	    restored_images: bool,
    61	    source_definitions: &BTreeMap<String, Table>,
    62	    authority_sources: &BTreeMap<String, Table>,
    63	) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    64	    retire_sources(tx,next,previous,now)?;
    65	    let have_dormant: bool = tx.conn().query_row(
    66	        "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_narrow_rows)",
    67	        [],
    68	        |r| r.get(0),
    69	    )?;
    70	    let type_change = previous.is_some_and(|old| {
    71	        next.tables.iter().any(|(name, t)| {
    72	            old.table(name).is_some_and(|p| {
    73	                t.columns
    74	                    .iter()
    75	                    .any(|(c, k)| p.columns.get(c).is_some_and(|old| old != k))
    76	                    || t.constraints
    77	                        .iter()
    78	                        .filter(|c| matches!(c, Constraint::Text { .. }))
    79	                        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
    80	                        != p.constraints
    81	                            .iter()
    82	                            .filter(|c| matches!(c, Constraint::Text { .. }))
    83	                            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
    84	            })
    85	        })
    86	    });
    87	    if !have_dormant && !type_change && !restored_images {
    88	        return Ok(());
    89	    }
    90	    let mut newly_retained = 0u64;
    91	    // Stream on the primary key. Do not retain a store-sized list of images.
    92	    restore_images(tx,next,now,source_definitions,authority_sources,false)?;
    93	    tx.clear_activation_scan();
    94	    // References to a hidden row hide their dependents, including memberships.
    95	    loop {
    96	        let mut removed = 0u64;
    97	        for (name, table) in next
    98	            .tables
    99	            .iter()
   100	            .filter(|(n, t)| t.ephemeral.is_none() && next.maintain_for(n).is_none())
   101	        {
   102	            let t = tx.num(name)?;
   103	            super::activation::walk(tx, t, |id, mut row| {
   104	                if let Some(source)=authority_sources.get(name) {
   105	                    if crate::engine::through_activation::Retirement::retires_image(table,source,&row,now) {
   106	                        tx.delete(name,source,&row)?;
   107	                        return Ok(());
   108	                    }
   109	                }
   110	                crate::schema::materialize_optional_fields(
   111	                    &mut row,
   112	                    previous.and_then(|s| s.table(name)).unwrap_or(table),
   113	                );
   114	                let mut hidden = incompatible(tx,next, name, &row)?;
   115	                for (column, kind) in &table.columns {
   116	                    let mut edges = Vec::new();
   117	                    if let Ok(value) = row.field(column) {
   118	                        refs(kind, value, &mut edges);
   119	                    }
   120	                    for (parent, parent_id) in edges {
   121	                        let missing = next.table(&parent).is_none()
   122	                            || (!tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2)",params![tx.num(&parent)?,parent_id],|r|r.get::<_,bool>(0))?
   123	                                && reserved(tx, tx.num(&parent)?, &parent_id)?);
   124	                        if missing {
   125	                            hidden = true;
   126	                        }
   127	                    }
   128	                }
   129	                if !hidden {
   130	                    return Ok(());
   131	                }
   132	                let retained: bool = tx.conn().query_row(
   133	                    "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2)",
   134	                    params![t, id],
   135	                    |r| r.get(0),
   136	                )?;
   137	                let outputs:std::collections::BTreeSet<_>=next.backfills.iter().filter(|f|f.table==*name).flat_map(|f|f.outputs.iter().cloned()).collect();
   138	                if retained && !outputs.is_empty() {
   139	                    // Preserve the original source/provenance, updating only
   140	                    // authoritative cells this release explicitly transformed.

   204	    tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE r.t=_dormant_narrow_rows.t AND r.id=_dormant_narrow_rows.id)",[])?;
   205	    if newly_retained > 0 || restored > 0 {
   206	        tx.set_meta("activation_population", "true")?;
   207	    }
   208	    Ok(())
   209	}

   211	pub(super) fn reserved(tx: &Tx<'_>, t: i64, id: &str) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
   212	    if !present(tx.conn())? {
   213	        return Ok(false);
   214	    }
   215	    Ok(tx.conn().query_row(
   216	        "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2)",
   217	        params![t, id],
   218	        |r| r.get(0),
   219	    )?)
   220	}

   247	pub(super) fn retire_sources(tx:&Tx<'_>,next:&Schema,previous:Option<&Schema>,now:i64)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
   248	    let backfilling=!next.backfills.is_empty() || super::backfills::has_evidence(tx)?;
   249	    // An expired predecessor must not be archived and later revived without its lifetime.
   250	    if let Some(previous) = previous {
   251	        let retirement = crate::engine::through_activation::Retirement::new(next, previous, now);
   252	        for (name, old) in &previous.tables {
   253	            if next.tables.contains_key(name) && (retirement.affects(name) || backfilling) {
   254	                super::activation::walk(tx, tx.num(name)?, |_, row| {
   255	                    if retirement.retires(name, &row) || backfilling && old.expired(&row,now) {
   256	                        tx.delete(name, old, &row)?;
   257	                    }
   258	                    Ok(())
   259	                })?;
   260	            }
   261	        }
   262	    }
   263	    Ok(())
   264	}

   266	// Restore retained source images before backfill evaluation. Candidate-owned
   267	// output cells are checked after transformation, so a same-column enum rename
   268	// does not preclude its own source image from entering the snapshot.
   269	pub(super) fn restore_images(tx:&Tx<'_>,next:&Schema,now:i64,source_definitions:&BTreeMap<String,Table>,authority_sources:&BTreeMap<String,Table>,for_backfills:bool)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
   270	    let rewritten=if for_backfills {super::backfills::columns(tx,next)?}else{Default::default()};
   271	    let mut cursor = (0i64, String::new());
   272	    loop {
   273	        let item: Option<(i64,String,i64,i64)> = tx.conn().query_row(
   274	            "SELECT t,id,octet_length(data),octet_length(definition) FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE (t,id)>(?1,?2) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE r.t=_dormant_narrow_rows.t AND r.id=_dormant_narrow_rows.id) ORDER BY t,id LIMIT 1",
   275	            params![cursor.0,cursor.1],|r|Ok((r.get(0)?,r.get(1)?,r.get(2)?,r.get(3)?))).optional()?;
   276	        let Some((t,id,data_bytes,definition_bytes))=item else {break};
   277	        // Retain one admitted provenance/image unit through decode, overlays,
   278	        // reconciliation and encoding. Never own its blobs before this bound.
   279	        let mut admission=crate::meter::Meter::new(crate::meter::Ceilings::job(),crate::meter::Cut::Abort);
   280	        if super::live_activation::active(tx)? {
   281	            admission.heap((data_bytes as u64).saturating_add(definition_bytes as u64).saturating_mul(64).saturating_add(8192))?;
   282	        }
   283	        let (data,definition):(String,String)=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT data,definition FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",params![t,id],|r|Ok((r.get(0)?,r.get(1)?)))?;
   284	        cursor = (t, id.clone());
   285	        let name: String =
   286	            tx.conn()
   287	                .query_row("SELECT name FROM _catalog WHERE num=?1", [t], |r| r.get(0))?;
   288	        let Some(table) = next
   289	            .table(&name)
   290	            .filter(|t| t.ephemeral.is_none() && next.maintain_for(&name).is_none())
   291	        else {
   292	            continue;
   293	        };
   294	        let old: Table =
   295	            serde_json::from_str(&definition).map_err(|e| RuntimeError::Store(e.to_string()))?;
   296	        super::dormant::check_owner(tx, &name, &old, next)?;
   297	        let mut row: Value =
   298	            serde_json::from_str(&data).map_err(|e| RuntimeError::Store(e.to_string()))?;
   299	        super::backfills::record_omissions(tx,t,&id,&row)?;
   300	        crate::schema::materialize_optional_fields(&mut row,&old);
   301	        if for_backfills && old.expired(&row,now) {
   302	            // Expose an expired source only inside the uncommitted lifecycle
   303	            // phase so the ordinary engine can close its reference actions.
   304	            tx.conn().execute("INSERT INTO r(t,id,data) VALUES(?1,?2,?3)",params![t,id,canonical_json(&row)])?;
   305	            continue;
   306	        }
   307	        let mut authority=crate::engine::through_activation::manual_authority_fields(next,&name,&old);
   308	        if for_backfills { authority.extend(rewritten.get(&name).into_iter().flatten().cloned()); }
   309	        if incompatible_except(tx,next,&name,&row,&authority)? {
   310	            continue;
   311	        }
   312	        // Retained source deadlines precede projection, including removal of read-through itself.
   313	        if crate::engine::through_activation::Retirement::retires_image(table,&old,&row,now)  {
   314	            tx.delete(&name,&old,&row)?;
   315	            continue;
   316	        }
   317	        // Actual deletion/reuse never recaptures a different parent lifetime.
   318	        let invalid_columns = tx
   319	            .conn()
   320	            .prepare_cached(
   321	                "SELECT column_name FROM _dormant_refs WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND invalid=1",
   322	            )?
   323	            .query_map(params![t, id], |r| r.get::<_, String>(0))?
   324	            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
   325	        let mut invalid=false;
   326	        for c in &invalid_columns {
   327	            if for_backfills && next.backfills.iter().any(|f| f.table==name && f.inputs.contains_key(c)) {
   328	                return Err(RuntimeError::Structural{code:"E_ADOPT",message:format!("backfill historical reference {name}.{c} on {id} lost its parent lifetime")});
   329	            }
   330	            if table.columns.contains_key(c) && !super::authority_origin::obsolete_ref(tx,t,&id,c,table,Some(&old))? {invalid=true;}
   331	        }
   332	        if invalid {
   333	            continue;
   334	        }
   335	        if super::authority_origin::live_row(tx,t,&id,&old,table)? {
   336	            admission.heap(crate::engine::through_activation::restored_parent_scratch(next,source_definitions,&name,&old).saturating_add(crate::rows::disclosed::decode_reservation(table).saturating_mul(4)))?;
   337	        }
   338	        super::authority_origin::record(tx,t,&id,&old)?;
   339	        super::authority_origin::validate(tx,next,authority_sources,&name,&old,&row,now,true)?;
   340	        crate::engine::through_activation::forward_image(tx,next,authority_sources,&name,&old,&row,now)?;
   341	        if old.through.as_ref().is_some_and(|e|e.live.is_some()) {tx.conn().execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO temp._live_restored(kind,t,col,id) VALUES('live-authority',?1,'',?2)",params![t,id])?;}
   342	        for column in old.columns.keys() {
   343	            if !table.columns.contains_key(column) {
   344	                super::dormant::definition(tx, &name, &old, column)?;
   345	                if let Ok(value) = row.field(column) {
   346	                    super::dormant::save_cell(tx, &name, &old, &id, column, value, false)?;
   347	                }
   348	            }
   349	        }
   350	        if !for_backfills { if let Value::Row(fields) | Value::Map(fields) = &mut row {
   351	            fields.retain(|c, _| table.columns.contains_key(c));
   352	        }}
   353	        let values=super::dormant::restored_values(tx,t,&id,table,&mut admission)?;
   354	        super::authority_origin::overlay(tx,t,&id,Some(&old),table,&mut row,values)?;
   355	        if old.through.as_ref().is_none_or(|e|e.live.is_some()) {
   356	            for column in table.columns.keys() {super::dormant::mark_live_column(tx,t,&id,column)?;}
   357	        }
   358	        crate::engine::through_activation::manual_image(tx,next,&name,&old,&mut row,now)?;
   359	        if if for_backfills {incompatible_except(tx,next,&name,&row,&authority)?}else{incompatible(tx,next,&name,&row)?} {continue;}
   360	        if !for_backfills {crate::schema::materialize_optional_fields(&mut row, table);}
   361	        // Missing required new fields are a genuine backfill refusal, not dormancy.
   362	        tx.conn().execute(
   363	            "INSERT INTO r(t,id,data) VALUES(?1,?2,?3)",
   364	            params![t, id, canonical_json(&row)],
   365	        )?;
   366	    }
   367	    tx.clear_activation_scan();
   368	    Ok(())
   369	}
